reference.title: Scenario 4 — Equation in a list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a bulleted or numbered list where one of the list items contains a Word

section.p: Consider a bulleted or numbered list where one of the list items contains a Word equation object either inline within the item text or as a standalone block paragraph at the list level.

row.entry: [List Bullet]: Use the formula [Equation object: A = πr²] to calculate area. [List Bullet]: Round results to two decimal places.

entry.codeblock:
• Use the formula A = π r 2 to calculate area.
  • Round results to two decimal places.

section.p: Result: When an equation object is embedded inline within a list item paragraph, the converter preserves it as an <equation-inline> element inside the <li> element. The equation is treated as part of the list item's inline content and remains within the list structure. If the equation is placed as a standalone paragraph inside the list (not inline within item text), the converter may wrap it in <equation-block> inside the <li>, depending on how the Word list indentation is applied.
